body:
Dogfood run record — isolated-posture, real-machine boot of the hotcrm SaaS shape (maintainer-ordered, 2026-08-27, verbatim: 「现在跑 isolated posture 的真机 dogfood」).

**Rig**: cloud `scripts/dev-local/run-hotcrm-saas.sh` (composed-artifact mode, `OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated`, minted enterprise licence), framework at main via the workspace links, artifact built from hotcrm@main with `HOTCRM_COMPOSITION=saas` — with two recorded stand-ins: the artifact copy had the #12497 retired keys stripped (exactly what the existing spec conversion does; unmodified artifact refuses to boot — objectstack-ai/objectstack#12772), and `sys_user.email_verified` was set directly in the DB in place of a mail transport (cloud#1683). Platform owner + two self-serve tenants created through the real auth/org APIs.

**Verification battery — 13/13 PASS** (API through the wall + SQLite ground truth under it):

- Per-tenant seed replay: each tenant org received exactly 13 `crm_product` rows stamped with its own `organization_id` (catalog family only); demo objects (`crm_account`/`crm_contact`/`crm_opportunity`/`crm_case`) empty for tenants — the #1362 SaaS composition behaves as designed on a real walled boot.
- Isolation with a falsifiable sentinel: tenant A's created product visible to A, invisible to B; zero foreign-org rows in either tenant's reads.
- Tenant authority: `/meta` view write refused 403 `FORBIDDEN`; packaged-flow toggle refused 403 (capability tier fires first for a `member_default` tenant; the §5 posture gate stands behind it).
- Operator authority: platform owner toggles a packaged flow off and on (200), and `sys_metadata_activation` carries the durable install-level row (`flow · case_escalation · app.objectstack.hotcrm · organization_id NULL`), retained with `active=1` after re-enable — the ADR-0126 §4/§6-wall-3 semantics observed live on a walled deployment (the #12438 D2 environment gap, now exercised).
- Per-org projection: each founded org received its own 14-set `sys_permission_set` catalog (hotcrm's 6 sets included), positions, and sharing rules.

**Findings carded**: #12772 (v17-line artifact compatibility break — retired-key tombstones refuse 17.x-built artifacts at every artifact door while the ADR-0087 conversion sits unused), #12773 (plugin-auth audience log crash turns 4xx refusals into blind 500s), cloud#1682 (security-enterprise tenant-column false-negative on `crm_contract`, hierarchy scope fail-closed on a healthy table), cloud#1683 (dev-local rig drift: owner email, audience posture, verification path).

Not run: the browser/console leg — the local EE rig carries no vendored `@object-ui/console` bundle (an environment condition of this rig; the multi-org claims above ride the same HTTP surface the UI does). DB evidence retained at the run's workdir.

🤝 **HANDOVER RUNBOOK — the incoming PM's work queue for this program**

Maintainer order, 2026-08-28, verbatim and untranslated: 「更新你的 epic 卡片，我让新人接手。 12843 也让新项目经理用 fable 审核」 and 「要写清楚交接内容，确保新项目经理顺利接手并继续完成后续所有开发。」

Chartering session `session_01SVYmuhHW6qZmNBqciaS7BN` stands down. This comment is the operating half of the handover; the card body carries the settled contract. Nothing below needs the chat history.

## 0. Territory and the repo rules that apply to it

This program spans three repos and each has a different seat discipline:

- **objectstack** — multi-lane. `domain:*` / type / grading are produced by the triage seat ALONE; an execution seat consumes those labels and never re-grades. A mislabel is `pm:retriage` + a dissent comment, never a self-correction.
- **objectstack-ai/hotcrm** and **objectstack-ai/cloud** — single-lane. Their `repo:*` seats self-run the mechanical three (own sweep, own `type`, own first-touch grading of `finding`s) and produce no `domain:*`. hotcrm additionally has a charter (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/hotcrm.md`): it is the exemplar app — platform gaps found while building it are filed **upstream in objectstack**, never worked around inside the app, and hotcrm consumes **released** `@objectstack/*` versions, never git pins (that is why hotcrm#1369 waits on a release and not on a merge).

## 1. Do now — the only in-flight item

**#12772 / PR #12843** (`priority:p0`, `target:v17`). Code complete, `7eff896`, 32/32 green, `mergeable_state: clean`, not enqueued, `needs:contract-review` armed on both carriers. The full step-by-step (tier proof → claim → what exactly to review → clear both carriers → landing pre-checks → queue → post-merge checks) is the [handover comment on #12772](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/12772#issuecomment-5448682863). The claim there is **released** (assignee cleared) so you can claim it cleanly.

Requires a seat running `claude-fable-5` — that is the maintainer's instruction and also the mechanical gate: clause-② content limb (the PR widens what the artifact door accepts), so it cannot enqueue below `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.

## 2. Then, in this order

| # | Work | Owner / lane | Unlock condition |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | **objectstack-ai/cloud#1688** — composed-artifact door (`OS_COMPOSED_ARTIFACT_URL`) consumes the same versioned conversion policy. Consume, don't reimplement: the policy was deliberately landed in `@objectstack/metadata-core` (spec-only dependency) for exactly this. Pin both directions against a real derived fixture, mirror the framework PR's fixture pattern. | cloud lane | `Blocked-by:` #12772 clears the moment PR #12843 merges (cloud consumes the framework via workspace links → merged = installable, no release wait) |
| 2 | **objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1369** — grant `manage_org_presentation` to `tenant_admin` in the SaaS composition, plus the positive pin. Mechanical once unblocked. | hotcrm lane | `Restart-when:` is executable and written on the card: the capability must appear in a **released** `@objectstack/spec` hotcrm can install. Releases are a human act — this card wakes on one, it never asks for one |
| 3 | **Four findings await first-touch grading** — #12844 and #12850 (objectstack; triage seat grades), objectstack-ai/cloud#1682 and #1683 (cloud lane self-grades), objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1363 (hotcrm lane self-grades). ⛔ Not the execution seat's to grade; supply evidence, not a verdict. | respective lanes | now |
| 4 | **Cloud EE acceptance boot of `HOTCRM_COMPOSITION=saas`** | cloud lane | ruled deferred until a real SaaS deployment of that shape exists (verification-strategy ruling recorded on hotcrm#1361). The seat that stands one up files it then |

Of these, only **cloud#1682** is a live correctness defect (a healthy `crm_contract` is mis-detected as lacking `organization_id`, so `sales_manager`'s `own_and_reports` write scope is fail-closed off on every walled deployment). It is worth grading early.

## 3. Settled — do not re-derive or re-litigate

- The four measured baseline facts in the card body (NULL-org rows are global; `manage_metadata` was the single platform-wide key; per-org replay exists but has no per-family selection; the ADR-0126 ledger is install-level and operator-gated).
- The maintainer's four rulings in the card body (isolated posture · per-tenant data · **no** per-tenant custom fields · seeds are per-tenant reference copies).
- ADR-0126's walls (§6.1 no `allowOrgOverride` flips on behavioral types; §9's not-chartered list). A card that cannot be built inside them is a stop-and-report to the maintainer, not a workaround.

## 4. Traps this program actually hit — do not pay for them twice

1. **A green local gate union is not a green CI.** Two rounds were lost to it on PR #12843. (a) Run `check:type-check-debt --re-measure` under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096` — CI's tsc heap ceiling is lower than the container default and only CI failed. (b) `check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary` is invisible to path derivation, so introducing any new SCREAMING_SNAKE code literal ships green locally and red on CI — that is #12850, filed to mechanize.
2. **Main moves under an in-flight PR and can move a pin's meaning.** The merge-queue red on #12843 was main's #12845 (retired-defaulted-key residue tolerance) landing mid-flight. Diagnose a queue red on the **merged tree**, never on the branch alone, and re-aim a pin rather than weaken it.
3. **A public d.ts that references the `@objectstack/spec` ROOT** makes every downstream type program load the ~2MB root twice and OOMs a large program on CI. Speak a structural mirror in the public surface, pinned in both assignability directions.
4. **The local dogfood rig is drifted** (three auth walls: declared owner email, audience posture, verification path). Do not debug it from scratch — objectstack-ai/cloud#1683 carries the working recipe. The rig's database lives in the chartering session's scratch container and is **gone**; reproduce from the recipe if you need evidence again.
5. **The composed-artifact boot needs the composition's own artifact**: build hotcrm with `HOTCRM_COMPOSITION=saas` and boot it through cloud's `run-hotcrm-saas.sh` with `--artifact`. Until #12772 lands, a 17.1-built artifact must have the two retired keys stripped from a copy or the boot refuses.

## 5. Closing condition for this epic

Close when **PR #12843 merges** — that restores the SaaS shape's boot path, which is the last thing between this program and "hotcrm runs as a single-DB multi-org SaaS". Items 2-4 in the queue above are separately carded with their own unlock conditions and do not hold this card open.
